title: Slovakian Beef Burger
description: A gluten-free Slovakian twist on the classic beef burger, featuring a flavorful roasted beef patty topped with roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: Beef burgers (made from 90% beef)
ingredients.notes: Use a meat thermometer to ensure internal temperature reaches 63°C for medium-rare

ingredients.name: Slovakian-style paprika
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality paprika for best flavor

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: Roasted bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Use any color bell pepper for best flavor

ingredients.name: Roasted onions
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet onion variety for best flavor

ingredients.name: Bun (gluten-free)
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality gluten-free bun for best texture

ingredients.name: Lettuce
ingredients.notes: Use any lettuce variety for best crunch

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Use any tomato variety for best flavor

ingredients.name: Cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: Use any cheese variety for best flavor

instructions: Season beef burgers with Slovakian-style paprika and cook in oven for 12-15 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 63°C for medium-rare.
While burgers are cooking, slice roasted bell peppers and onions into thin strips.
Toast gluten-free buns in oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Assemble burgers by spreading a layer of olive oil on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked beef burger, a few slices of roasted bell peppers and onions, a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, and finally the top bun.
If using cheese, place on top of burger before serving.
